source.semantics: Analyzer area RECT uses clipped processor ROI, not nonzero or density population bounds. Roi/OvalRoi(double): truncate min origin, ceil extent. Float PolygonRoi: floor Float32 minima, ceil maxima, including actual fitted processing vertices. Unclipped degenerate zero-height box retains origin/width; clipping any no-overlap rectangle resets all4 to0. Whole rectangle uses full image bounds and calibration, unlike detached Feret fallback. Width/Height use positive spacing; BX/BY use cal.getX/getY. InvertY uses yOrigin when nonzero, otherwise imageHeight-y-1.60all-NaN cases preserve rectangle independently of zero area.
source.native_affine: Native captured affine transforms processor origin at captured plane Z; Width/Height are physical image-axis edge norms. Preserve full origin and edge vectors as readonly summaries so a sheared/3D rectangle is not collapsed to a world-axis box. Java only proves its axis-aligned calibration conventions.
